title: Smoother play and lots of fixes
notes: Tallgrass is much lighter on your PC while it hunts in the background, most of all with a big PC.
Toucannon can now learn Beak Blast: pick it in its Moves. It heats up first and strikes last, and a Pokémon that touches Toucannon while it heats up is burned.
Auctions > My bids: Running and Ended groups with counts, the ones ending soonest first. Finished ones leave after a day, unless you still have one to bring in.
Auctions: a big or full-screen window shows as many rows of auctions as fit.
fixes: U-turn, Volt Switch and Flip Turn now switch you out even when they knock the foe out, as long as the foe has another Pokémon to send.
Baneful Bunker, Spiky Shield, King’s Shield, Silk Trap, Obstruct and Burning Bulwark now punish the contact moves they block, like in the main games.
Corrosion now lets its Pokémon poison Poison and Steel types.
Silvally now keeps Type: Null’s Legendary power in battle.
Poison Puppeteer: a Pokémon that Pecharunt poisons is now confused too.
Live 3v3 and raids keep their current battle rules for now: these battle changes reach them in a later update.
Card Rush: cards now drop from the very start of a rush.
Fixed a short freeze every few seconds while hunting with a very large collection.
The Live 3v3 team screen no longer stutters on every catch for players with lots of friends.
Night Market on phones: the Buy, Put it up and Glimmer Shop buttons are always on screen again.
Phones: event banners fit the screen with their X always in reach, and no longer cover the buttons under them.
Phones: the Level-up moves list in Party & PC shows every move name and fits the screen.
Tower on phones: the Scanner button no longer hides your squad’s held items.
Stamp book: with lots of prize balls, Open all fits the screen, so Skip and Nice! can always be pressed.
Stamp book: a prize ball is only marked as opened once everything inside it has reached you.
Discharge’s move text reads correctly again.
Candy for alternate forms (Super Size Pumpkaboo, Rotom forms, Unown and more) now shows its icon.
The Wonder Card Purple card is actually purple now.
Style: the -30% daily deal tags show in front of the item again.
Hard Mode Tower: Poké Balls you just got no longer disappear when you open the Tower tab or switch devices mid-climb.
Windows: minimising another app no longer brings the Tallgrass window up.
PC filter “Evolving fills a stamp” now also shows Pokémon that need an item or a few more levels first.
Gilded, Glitched and costume Buddies now show their look on the You page, your trainer card and to friends.
Guild Boss War: the tab and the counter planner stay smooth with a big PC.
A costumed Pokémon whose outfit got mixed up after restoring a save shows the right outfit again, offers the right evolutions and keeps its costume when it evolves.
Safari Ladder: the points tip says exactly what counts, and the trip summary no longer shows points for finds the Ladder doesn’t count.
Auto-file: switching devices no longer resets your rules, and the starting rule “Every species into its own box” now begins switched off.
Thunder God Mythic Ball: the lightning no longer stays on screen when you change island or the encounter ends while the ball is in the air.
Switching devices: Pokémon you caught or hatched and gifts you opened on your other device since its last cloud save now come back.
PC: the Pokémon detail card no longer slows the PC down while it is open.
Night Market: smoother on phones and slower PCs, and its lanterns, stars and rare-stall shine hold still with Animations off.
Friends: searching a long friend list no longer stutters while you type.
Live 3v3 on phones: the team screen fits, the 3 slots and the whole PC picker use the full width, and Challenge a friend opens its own list.
Live 3v3 on phones: the Looking for a trainer card no longer covers your money bar or hides its own clock.
Night Market on phones: the stalls are full size again (the text was tiny).
Community Live finds on phones: the Everyone and Mine filters are always in reach, and Pokémon names are no longer cut off.
Friends on phones: every button is bigger and easier to tap.

title: Small fixes
notes: The Wiki button is now the Guide button: it opens a “what to do next” page first.
Community: anyone can react to any shared find, and everyone sees the reactions.
Community: cheers are for your friends’ finds, on the Friends filter.
Friends’ pop-ups now stack in one corner, and a burst of them folds into one card.
PvP is now Live 3v3 only: the PvP page shows the Open League and the Lv 50 League. Classic Ranked, which has ended, is no longer shown.
Friend battles are Live 3v3 challenges now (no rating): the Battle and Rematch buttons open Live 3v3.
PvP page: the gold Season 2 ribbon keeps the final Top 100 of classic Ranked.
Night Market: the Record board has a new Top 100 Glimmer board. See who holds the most Glimmer, and your own place.
Pokémon cards in your PC now show an estimated Glimmer price, from recent Night Market sales.
fixes: Raid Eggs: new eggs show up again for players who raid a lot (the “No rolls left for now” pill).
Ranked 3v3: a Focus Sash no longer brings a Pokémon back after a two-hit move like Dragon Darts knocks it out.
Catch rules: a rare Pokémon your rules don’t catch now says so, instead of saying you were out of balls.
Full Art cards found while you were away: the summary can always be closed, on phones and in the browser too.
Full Art Pokémon in your party show their card’s scenery behind them again.
Pumpkaboo’s Full Art card: the stray pixels by its stem are gone.
Night Market History: costume Pokémon show in their costume in Going prices, priced apart from the plain ones.
Glimmer from rare finds no longer stops for some players with a big PC.

title: Small fixes
fixes: Phones: Raid, the PC picker, Blackjack, the You and Friends pages and the Community bar now fit on the screen.
Community feed: cheer counts show correctly again.
